rows.en:
(When I wander around like this
with nothing in particular to do...)
(Sure enough, I ran into Luis-san...)

I was just taking a little walk.
What are you up to, Luis-san?

Me?
I was just about to go get some grub.
There's a tasty hot dog joint around here, right?
Oh, that place that's famous for being good.

Running into you here must be fate or somethin'.
You're hungry, right? It's on me, so come along.
Huh? Oh, okay!
Thanks for the treat, Luis-san.

What're you being so polite for!
Don't sweat it. Eat up and grow big!

Okay!
...Wait, what's that hot dog?
It looks ridiculously spicy!
*munch munch*... Hm, this?

This is......
the Super Chili-Chili Dog Infinity!!
rows.notes: 'Infinity' written out for the infinity sign (glyph not in the ASCII set; the Japanese glosses it as infinitii).

rows.en: Super Chili-Chili Dog Infinity.........
rows.notes: 'Infinity' written out for the infinity sign (glyph not in the ASCII set; the Japanese glosses it as infinitii).

rows.en:
It's so hot it makes the blood in your whole
body run backward. Wanna try a bite?
Uh, no, I'll pass.

Don't be shy, just try it!
Come on, say 'aah'!!

Huh, wait, don't... Not by force......
Please sto...! Mmph!
Spiiiiiiicyyyyyy!!
W-W-W-W-W-W-W-Water!!!
Ugh... That was so spicy......

If somethin' like this throws you off,
it proves your passion ain't proportional
to your volume yet.

(My passion isn't proportional to my volume...?
I have no idea what that means,
Luis-san...)

Train your tongue so you can eat it right
next time! Daily effort never lets you down!

(How do you even train a tongue?
Is this a passion thing too?)

Now that my belly's full, guess I'll head home.
See ya.

Oh, okay.
Thanks for the meal today, Luis-san!

(Come to think of it, whenever I meet Luis-san,
it's always just by chance around town.)

(Hmm, I'd like to get to know
Luis-san a little better...)
(Sure enough, I ran into Luis-san...)

(How do you even train a tongue?
Is this a passion thing too?)

(Come to think of it, whenever I meet Luis-san,
it's always just by chance around town.)

(Hmm, I'd like to get to know
Luis-san a little better...)

(I suddenly got a craving for a chili dog
and came here, but...)
(Sure enough, Luis-san's here.)

Kaaah, that's good!!
A chili dog's gotta be at least this spicy!
(Super Chili-Chili Dog Infinity...)
rows.notes: 'Infinity' written out for the infinity sign (glyph not in the ASCII set; the Japanese glosses it as infinitii).

rows.en:
All right! Belly's full, so let's go do a show!
Everybody! Listen to my sooong!!

(I can't believe he can actually eat
that spicy chili dog...)

(If my passion overflowed like Luis-san's,
could I eat it with no problem too...?)

(Wait, what does it even mean
for passion to overflow?)
(Sure enough, Luis-san's here.)

(I can't believe he can actually eat
that spicy chili dog...)

(If my passion overflowed like Luis-san's,
could I eat it with no problem too...?)

(Wait, what does it even mean
for passion to overflow?)
(Wow, Sky Gate really is huge...)

(Hm? Isn't that Luis-san?
He seems kind of different from usual...)
U-Um, Luis-san?

Hm? Oh, if it isn't Fresh Boy.
What are you doing here?

Oh, nothing in particular...
What are you doing here, Luis-san?
Nah, just... a little something...

(Luis-san really does seem
kind of down today...)

Come to think of it, I made a promise
to do a show here with 'em...
rows.notes: aitsu = Luis's late friend, gender unknown: 'em/they.

rows.en: Huh? With who?
...Somebody who used to be my pal.

Lookin' at you closely, you kinda
got the same vibe as 'em...
Um... Is something wrong?
Nah, it's nothin'. Forget it.

This ain't like me...
Wallowing in sorrow, of all things...

All right, let's sing for a change of pace!
You sing too! Let's move that mountain!!
Listen to our sooooooong!!!!!

Come on, you shout too!!
Like you want it to ring across the galaxy!!!
Listen to our song!!

Not enough! It's not enough!!
Satisfy meeeee!!!

(Just shouting before we even sang
has wrecked my throat...)

You were shining brighter than usual today...
See ya.

(Luis-san seemed like he was forcing
himself to be cheerful today...)

(The pal he 'used to' have...
don't tell me they're already......)
(Wow, Sky Gate really is huge...)

(Hm? Isn't that Luis-san?
He seems kind of different from usual...)

Hm? Oh, if it isn't Fresh Girl.
What are you doing here?
Listen to our song!!
Listen to our sooooooong!!!!!

(Just shouting before we even sang
has wrecked my throat...)

(Luis-san seemed like he was forcing
himself to be cheerful today...)

(The last time I ran into Luis-san here,
he seemed really down, but...)
(Oh, it's Luis-san.)
(...He does seem down compared to usual...)

I know I can't keep moping around forever!
I know that, but...!
Dammit!!

uncertain: c08485/c08486/c08509: the dish name has an infinity sign glossed 'infinitii'; written 'Super Chili-Chili Dog Infinity' (base name per glossary) since the sign is outside the ASCII set.
c08525-c08529/c08541: aitsu/dachi = Luis's (apparently late) friend, gender unknown; neutral 'em/they/somebody/pal'.

c08534 (Luis and male player) and c08546 (female player) differ only in ore-tachi/watashi-tachi, both 'our': same English. Echoes Basara's line; c08510 'Listen to my sooong!!' matches c08787 in a finished slice.
c08549/c08552 worded to match their female twins c08556/c08557 already translated in slice 116.
